summary: MoneyHero Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 24, 2026, reporting its unaudited first quarter 2026 results via a press release for the period ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, disclosing financial performance such as revenue of $16.5 million, a 15% year-over-year increase, and an Adjusted EBITDA loss narrowing to $(1.1) million. It includes management commentary on operational progress but does not involve any special-situation event like an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. This is an ordinary current report of financial results.
